name: Traders Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Traders Holdings Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in foreign exchange and securities trading activities in Japan. The company offers Minna no FX, which provides foreign exchange margin trading services; Minna no Option, which provides forex binary options trading services; LIGHT FX, which offers foreign exchange margin trading services; Minna no Shisutore, which offers system trading of foreign exchange margin trading services; and Minna no Coin, which offers cryptocurrency margin trading services.
